needed.evidence: no purpose-built sidewalk, people must walk in the road or on the shoulder
needed.suggestion: Construct a continuous sidewalk on the left side of the road to separate pedestrians from vehicle traffic.

needed.evidence: the footway is an informal path under 1m and heavily blocked by shops and stalls
needed.suggestion: Install a proper, unobstructed sidewalk on the right side to provide a safe walking space.

needed.evidence: shop fronts and stalls extend into the walking area
needed.suggestion: Implement zoning regulations to ensure shop fronts do not obstruct the pedestrian path.

needed.evidence: uneven ground and debris along the informal path
needed.suggestion: Level and pave the right-side pedestrian area to remove trip hazards.

needed.evidence: high crossing demand due to commercial shops on both sides but no designated crossing facility
needed.suggestion: Install a marked pedestrian crossing to provide a safe point for people to cross the road.
